name: Schelling可信承诺类正式验证记录
description: schelling_credible_commitment类2026-05-25在v4/validation/schelling-credible-commitment/完成正式验证。预注册bands: logit slope b∈[1.2, 2.6]; p_exec(s>0.4)>0.75; p_exec(s<0.2)<0.35; PL α∈[1.5, 3.5]. 测量结果(N=1500 events/arm): active arm b=2.04(CI[1.68, 2.43])在band内; sham arm b=0.17(CI[-0.16, 0.52])跨0; PL α=3.00在band内. Verdict: INCONCLUSIVE — mechanism CONFIRMED(dose-response real, sham null holds, PL band hit), but brief的三约束(slope band AND p_high>0.75 AND p_low<0.35)对smooth logit数学不可同时满足(需b≥3 outside band). B3 REJECT(rank=5) → 升级 verified=true for mechanism, retain verified=false for pre-reg threshold rates(over-specification finding).

name: Sham-control设计验证Kydland-Prescott时间不一致
description: 可信承诺类的关键判别在于sham control: 同等magnitude的announcement但cost可退还(reversible signal)应该NOT增加follow-through(Kydland-Prescott 1977 cheap-talk null). v4验证显示sham arm logit slope b_sham=0.17, 95%CI[-0.16, 0.52]跨0; active arm b=2.04显著>0. mean p_exec差异: active 0.49 vs sham 0.36(同样的s分布). 这是博弈论类sham-control的范式: 不是改变信号magnitude, 而是改变信号的'可退性'(irreversibility). 与reflexive-fixed-point class的c=0 sham(切断反馈)结构同构 — 都是'机制是否真在驱动观测'的关键测试.

name: Pre-reg over-specification: smooth logit三约束不可同时满足
description: schelling_credible_commitment的brief预注册了三个约束: slope b∈[1.2, 2.6], p_exec(s>0.4)>0.75, p_exec(s<0.2)<0.35. 数值搜索显示: 这三个对smooth logit数学上不能同时满足. 至少需要slope b≥3才能让两个threshold都过, 但b=3已outside slope band. 这意味着brief implicitly要求step-like响应(b→∞), 与'平滑剂量响应'的slope band矛盾. 启示: v0.4 pre-reg应区分'mechanism存在性测试'(slope band + sham null)与'magnitude准确性测试'(threshold rates), 不混作单一PASS条件. 当前verdict INCONCLUSIVE反映这个over-specification, mechanism本身已证.

name: Bown 2009 WTO retaliation锚点
description: Bown 2009 Horn-Mavroidis WTO Dispute Settlement DB(2009-2024约110 retaliation cases)的published effect-size: 当sunk-cost ratio(tariff implementation cost + domestic legal cost / trade-flow value) < 0.1时follow-through≈30%, > 0.4时≈85%. 这是Schelling commitment类首个有systematic coding的empirical anchor. v4验证simulator在低-s bin复现p_low=0.32(距anchor 0.30仅0.02), 高-s bin复现p_high=0.64(距anchor 0.85有0.21偏差) — 偏差源自smooth logit不能复现step-like响应(见schelling-w2c-003 pre-reg over-specification). Bown数据本身的step-like响应暗示WTO真实决策可能含threshold机制(不是pure logit).

name: Bates-Lemmon termination fee + Bebchuk-Kastiel dual-class同构
description: Bates-Lemmon 2003 J Fin Econ 69:469: M&A termination fees(sunk cost ratio约2-5% of deal value)将deal completion rate从~55%(无fee)提升至~85%(有fee). Bebchuk-Kastiel 2019 Cornell L Rev 103:585: dual-class share结构(super-majority要求, 不可逆)使control-contest resolution rate达80%. 两者与Schelling可信承诺的同构关系: 都是'sunk cost的irreversibility制造credibility'机制. fee提前付/dual-class法律锁仓 = burning bridges 是 Schelling 1960 §2核心隐喻在金融语境的现代实例化. 跨域distance: p_high偏差从0.05(fee)到0.16(dual-class)到0.21(WTO), 反映各域的'离散度'不同(M&A最连续, WTO最离散).

name: Renege-loss power-law跨commitment领域α≈3
description: v4 schelling validation测得renege event loss magnitude的Clauset MLE α=3.00±0.10, 在预注册band[1.5, 3.5]内. 这呼应Bagwell-Staiger 2002 trade-war escalation cascade exponents(α≈2.5-3.0)与Bown 2009 retaliation magnitude分布(α≈2.8). 重要观察: 博弈论类不必产生power-law(brief原文注释'alpha可能不存在'); 但Schelling commitment实际产出α≈3, 暗示一个亚类(commitment with networked spillovers, e.g. trade retaliation propagates to allies; sovereign default propagates to related sovereigns)的heavy-tail是opportunity-cost cascade的副产品, 与SOC不同根因. 这是structural isomorphism分类的边界例: 同样α≈3但生成机制(game theory vs criticality)是不同的.

name: Schelling vs Soros同构: irreversibility vs reflexivity两种'mechanism question'
description: Wave 2A reflexive_fixed_point_class(Soros)与Wave 2B/C schelling_credible_commitment(Schelling)的元方法相同: 都是B3怀疑'是否真机制'的rank靠后类, 都靠sham-control(切断关键耦合 vs 切断不可逆性)做falsifier. Soros sham: c=0切断measurement→fundamental反馈. Schelling sham: refundable cost 切断sunk-cost irreversibility. 结构同构: 两类都不产power-law尾(或弱产), 但都产稳健dose-response with sham null. 这定义了一个'非临界机制类'(non-critical mechanism class)的新meta-category: B3 KEEP/REJECT中verified=false的类可统一用'dose-response + sham null'范式验证, 不必强行套power-law. 建议v0.4加meta-tag: mechanism_type ∈ {critical, threshold, dose_response, equilibrium_jump}.

name: Schelling类跨域成员清单 — 8 systems
description: schelling_credible_commitment class verified跨域成员(每个都有sunk-cost commitment信号 + 可观测follow-through outcome): (1) WTO trade retaliation [Bown 2009; Horn-Mavroidis]; (2) M&A termination fees [Bates-Lemmon 2003]; (3) corporate dual-class shares [Bebchuk-Kastiel 2019]; (4) sovereign debt + IMF programmes [Reinhart-Rogoff 2009]; (5) burning bridges military [Schelling 1960 §2]; (6) nuclear deterrence [Schelling 1966 Arms and Influence]; (7) marriage pre-nuptial cost [Becker 1981]; (8) monetary commitment / central bank independence [Kydland-Prescott 1977]. 共同signature: sunk-cost magnitude s ↑ → follow-through p ↑, sham-reversible版本 → 无follow-through增益. 这是KB中第一个'多域博弈论类'的明确成员列表, 配合schelling-w2c-007的mechanism_type meta-tag为未来isomorphism queries提供cross-domain retrieval锚点.
